notes:
### Added

- **Workbench Files view:** the Files tab is now a full workspace browser — a file tree sidebar plus editor tabs that open text files in Monaco and preview images, video, audio, PDF, DOCX and XLSX in place, with "reveal in Explorer" per tab.
- **Per-model override management:** model settings now show which overrides (context limit, max output tokens, capabilities, reasoning, visibility) differ from defaults for each model, and a Reset Models dialog restores factory defaults in one click.
- **Media preview in file-change diffs:** changed media files get an inline preview (e.g. audio player) inside the diff view instead of a plain text row.

### Changed

- **Tool output renders ANSI colors:** terminal-style tool output (test runs, builds) shows bold/colored ANSI text in tool cards instead of raw escape sequences.

### Fixed

- **Failed turns are no longer silent:** when a turn fails immediately (e.g. unknown model 404) with no assistant text or tools, the persisted error note now opens a failed turn in the transcript instead of disappearing.
